explanation: The king of Israel and son of King David, known for his wisdom and the building of the temple in Jerusalem.
A holy place dedicated to God, where people could come to worship and offer gifts.
A skilled craftsman from Tyre, brought by Solomon to work on the decoration of the temple.
Large vertical structures that support a building or architectural construction, which can also serve decorative purposes.
An alloy consisting mainly of copper and tin, used in producing various objects for the temple.
A large basin made of bronze and used for ritual cleansing before priests entered the temple.
Objects designed to hold light, often in the form of lamps or candles, used to provide illumination in the temple.
A structure where offerings and prayers are presented to God. In Solomon's temple there was a large bronze altar for burnt offerings and grain offerings.
A precious metal symbolizing wealth and purity, used abundantly in the decoration of the temple.
